description: Block time so nothing can be booked in it: a whole day (just `date`), a range of days (`date` and `end_date`), or part of a day (`date` with `start` and `end` times). Existing appointments in that time are NOT cancelled — this says which ones overlap.

end.description: For part of a day, e.g. "3pm".

end_date.description: Last day off, for a range.

start.description: For part of a day, e.g. "1pm".

name: block_time_off
title: Block time off on the calendar
